subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: Should CodexBar ship a built-in, persisted external-command hook surface with these six stable events and the proposed direct-exec, environment-isolation, payload, and logging contract?
rationale: The patch is deliberately capable of launching local processes and creates a long-lived app and CLI config API; tests can validate mechanics but cannot decide whether this capability belongs in CodexBar or whether the remaining trust model is acceptable.

options.title: Approve after argv repair
options.body: Accept the feature after the settings editor preserves exact argv values and focused round-trip coverage passes.

options.title: Narrow to config and CLI
options.body: Remove the GUI command editor and initially expose hooks only through explicit config plus CLI inspection and testing.

options.title: Decline built-in execution
options.body: Keep CodexBar observability-only and leave event-driven command automation outside the application.

recommendation.title: Approve after argv repair
recommendation.body: Accept the feature after the settings editor preserves exact argv values and focused round-trip coverage passes.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the strongest available owner for accepting a new user-facing execution and compatibility boundary.
